• Username- Nicolai156
  • Well as you can see in the title i got banned about almost 5 months ago for Hacking - Fly and Speed! I also ban evaded on three accounts. The accounts was McFanta_ that is supposed to be my original account, krisdenkule8 my brothers account and my friend chle_ that logged in to avicus when we had a sleepover when i hacked on this server!

Also this is not my main account but my backup account i use here but i really want to appeal my main account McFanta_!

I think this was all i could say i hope this will work if it dont i will try in the future :D good bye anyways!

~Nicolai156

title: Nicolai156,s appeal for Hacking!

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
Nicolai,

We are selective when appealing hackers, and especially ban evaders. I appreciate your honesty, and effort into the appeal, but what the result of your offense was was a legitimate ban, and rightfully so with the multiple other accounts you had evaded on. Unfortunately, I can't say that you are able to get rid of the punishment at this moment in time, but you always have the opportunity to appeal later on.

While you have also been honest about lying on two of the other appeals, it seems that lying to staff in the first place was a poor trait to have, and I can't determine whether or not I'd be able to let you back onto the server due to the deceptions that could occur. Once some time passes, you can try your hand at it again, and we might see a different outcome. Thank you for your patience.

Regards,
Kavinsky.
